## Pull request checklist

- [ ] One concern per PR; title states the change type (docs / pattern / standard / RA / research / ADR)
- [ ] New documents linked from their directory `README.md` index
- [ ] Naming conventions followed (kebab-case; ADRs numbered, never renumbered)
- [ ] Status, owner, and last-reviewed date set on modified standards/reference architectures

## Reviewer routing (see CONTRIBUTING.md for required reviewers)

- [ ] Editorial / pattern change — 1–2 architecture team reviewers
- [ ] Standard or reference architecture change — cross-cutting review requested (EA, Cloud Platform, Data, Cybersecurity)
- [ ] Security-relevant change — reviewed against [security/ai-security-controls.md](../security/ai-security-controls.md)

## Evidence (required for standards, build-vs-buy, and technology changes)

- [ ] Research brief / prototype results / production evidence linked
